text: Architect Walter Craig arrives at a country cottage in Kent and tells the guests he has seen them all in a recurring dream that ends in something awful. To test him they trade stories: a hearse driver who returns as a bus conductor [with just room for one inside|rules|death sends warnings], [a mirror that shows a husband another man's room|images|mirrors and glass], and a ventriloquist whose [dummy Hugo talks of leaving him for a rival|wants|taking someone's place]. As the evening wears on, Craig's dream begins to [close around him like a loop|archetypes|The Endless Night].
